blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones hydrogen cyanide se react kar ke cyanohydrins (hydroxynitriles) banate hain. HCN seedhe use nahi hoti kyunke yeh intehai zehreeli gas hai; is ki bajaye sodium ya potassium cyanide aur carbonyl compound ke aabi mehlool mein dheere dheere mineral acid (HCl) mila kar mixture mein hi banayi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanal (C par H3C aur H, C=O; C +delta, O -delta) + H-CN (H +delta, CN -delta), teer ke oopar KCN/HCl, se 2-hydroxypropanenitrile: aik C jis par H3C, OH, H aur CN.
blocks.caption: Ethanal aur HCN se 2-hydroxypropanenitrile (kitab ke PDF safha 104 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: CH3COCH3 + HCN -> (CH3)2C(OH)CN (2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile), KCN/HCl; yeh Perspex, aik shaffaf plastic, banane mein darmiyani maadda hai.

blocks.alt: Propanone (C=O wale C par do H3C; C +delta, O -delta) + H-CN, teer ke oopar KCN/HCl, se 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile: aik C jis par do H3C, OH aur CN.
blocks.caption: Propanone aur HCN se 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono reactions mein CN group carbonyl carbon se jur jata hai aur oxygen OH ban jata hai, is liye product mein aik hi carbon par OH aur CN dono hote hain (cyanohydrin). Kitab ne propanone wale product ka naam '2-hydroxy-2-methlypropanenitrile' chhapa hai; sahi hijje 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile hain.

Mechanism: HCN na achha nucleophile hai na itna taqatwar tezaab ke zyada cyanide ions de, is liye KCN thori zyada miqdar mein use hoti hai, jis se kuch azad CN- ions bachte hain jo reaction shuru karte aur munasib raftaar se chalate hain.

items: CN- delta+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta aur C=O ke pi electrons oxygen par chale jate hain, anion banta hai: RCHO + CN- <=> RCH(O-)CN.
Anion HCN se proton le kar hydroxynitrile banata aur CN- wapas deta hai: RCH(O-)CN + HCN <=> RCH(OH)CN + CN-.

blocks.alt: Teen qadam. i) KCN (Excess) + HCl (Limiting) -> HCN (Nucleophilic Reagent) + KCl. ii) RHC=O (C +delta, O -delta) + cyanide ion :C≡N (manfi charge) equilibrium mein anion ke saath: aik carbon par R, H, O- aur C≡N. iii) Yeh anion + H-CN (H +delta, CN -delta) equilibrium mein hydroxyalkanenitrile (O- ki jagah OH) + cyanide ion ke saath.
blocks.caption: HCN ke addition ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Qadam (i) mein thori zyada KCN aur kam HCl se HCN banti hai aur kuch azad CN- ions bach jate hain. Qadam (ii) mein CN- ka lone pair delta+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta aur O- wala anion banta hai. Qadam (iii) mein yeh anion HCN se H+ le kar hydroxyalkanenitrile banata aur CN- wapas deta hai, jo agla molecule shuru karta hai. Dono qadam ulat sakte hain, is liye equilibrium ke teer hain.
Nitriles halke tezaab ya aabi alkali se hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acids ya carboxylate ions dete hain (topic 23.4.1).

Kyunke aldehydes aur ketones alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain, un ki reduction se alcohols ban sakte hain. NaBH4 ya LiAlH4 jaise reducing agent se aldehydes primary alcohols aur ketones secondary alcohols dete hain: CH3CHO + 2[H] -> CH3CH2OH (NaBH4, paani/OH-); CH3COCH3 + 2[H] -> CH3CH(OH)CH3, propan-2-ol (NaBH4, alkaline aabi mehlool). Brackets mein [H] NaBH4 se milne wale hydrogen ki nishani hai jo mua'adla balance karta hai; is ka matlab atomic hydrogen nahi.

blocks.alt: Do mua'adle. Ethanal, CH3-C(=O)-H, + 2[H], teer ke oopar NaBH4 aur delta (garmi), neeche H2O/OH-, se ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH. Propanone, CH3-C(=O)-CH3, + 2[H], oopar NaBH4 Heat, neeche alkaline aqueous solution, se propan-2-ol, CH3-CH(OH)-CH3.
blocks.caption: NaBH4 se ethanal aur propanone ki reduction (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne propanone wale mua'adle mein 'alkalineaqucoussolution' aur product ka naam 'propane-2-ol' chhapa hai; sahi 'alkaline aqueous solution' aur propan-2-ol hain. Aldehyde (ethanal) se primary alcohol (ethanol) aur ketone (propanone) se secondary alcohol (propan-2-ol) banta hai.

blocks.alt: Hydride ion H:- (nucleophile) RHC=O (C +delta, O -delta; carbonyl compound) ke carbon par hamla karta hai: aik mura teer (curly arrow) hydride ke lone pair se C tak, doosra C=O bond se O tak. Is se alkoxide ion R-CH2-O- banta hai. Agle teer par H-OH (H +delta, OH -delta) ke saath alcohol R-CH2-OH + :OH- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Hydride ion se carbonyl compound ki reduction ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 106 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) ke saath condensation reaction kar ke wazeh pighalne ke darjon wale narangi qalmi thos dete hain. Reagent C=O group par jurta aur phir paani ka aik molecule nikal jata hai. Maslan ethanal ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone ke narangi qalmein deta hai: CH3CHO + H2N-NH-C6H3(NO2)2 -> CH3CH=N-NH-C6H3(NO2)2 + H2O.

blocks.alt: Ethanal (C=O par H3C aur H) + H2N-NH- jo benzene ring se jura hai, saamne NO2 aur saath O2N (2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine) -> ethanal-2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone, jis mein C=O ab C=N-NH- ban gaya, + H2O. Do qataron mein: pehle reactants, phir products.
blocks.caption: Ethanal aur 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine se ethanal-2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone aur paani (kitab ke PDF safha 106 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C=O ka oxygen aur hydrazine ke NH2 ke do H mil kar paani (H2O) ban kar nikal jate hain, aur carbon ab nitrogen se double bond (C=N) bana leta hai. Is liye ise addition-elimination ya condensation reaction kehte hain. Ring par NO2 groups positions 2 aur 4 par hain.
Yeh reagent carbonyl compounds ki pehchan mein use hota hai. Carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides, jin mein bhi C=O group hai, yeh test nahi dete.

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: aik mein peela-narangi maaya, doosri narangi qalmon (crystals) se bhari.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.2: Ethanal 2,4-DNPH ke saath narangi qalmi thos deta hai (kitab ki Figure 23.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: KCN ki maujoodgi mein propanone aur HCN ke reaction se kya banta hai, aur KCN kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, (CH3)2C(OH)CN. KCN azad CN- ions, yani nucleophile, deta hai; akeli HCN bohat kam deti hai.

items: HCN (KCN + HCl se) C=O par: hydroxynitriles; CN- wapas milta.
NaBH4/LiAlH4: aldehyde -> primary, ketone -> secondary alcohol.
2,4-DNPH: sirf aldehydes aur ketones ke saath narangi precipitate.
